comments.body:
I personally failed an exam from my agreement and had no issues booting it out. 

The master is doable in 3 semesters. I would have done that if it wasn‘t for me not finding a master thesis soon enough. This requires doing your internship next to courses though (only possible for me because of homeoffice). Most of my friends did at least 4 semesters.
comments.author: tpawn42
